title: Personal performance scorecard & weekly check-ins
content:
Context and intent:
This is my personal, lightweight scorecard for the Optimize product area. It lives in Drive as a scratchpad for weekly check-ins, quick retros, and experiment notes. Not an official product doc — more like a cockpit instrument panel that helps me make tradeoffs between delivery velocity and quality/regression risk.

Cadence and structure (how I use this):
- Quick weekly check-in (10–15m) on Mondays: update numbers, note 1 bright spot, 1 blocker, 2 next actions.
- Monthly mini-retro at end of month: surface recurring blockers, adjust focus areas.
- Keep short notes on experiments and what signal to watch for.

Northstar & leading indicators (personalized):
- Northstar: % of Optimize customers with active cost-saving config applied (target: 35% by end of Q4).
- Leading indicators I track weekly (signal + target):
  - Experiment velocity: PRs merged for Optimize experiments (target 3/week across infra+prod).
  - Eval pass rate: percentage of eval suites passing after model/quant changes (target >= 96%).
  - Latency p95 for internal benchmark (100-token): keep <= 120ms for default config.
  - Deep work hours: focused blocks >= 12 hours/week (personal productivity proxy).

This week's snapshot (2025-02-10 check-in):
- Bright spot: Canary of prefix caching landed in Dedicated and showed 18% token cost reduction on replay workload.
- Blocker: Autoscaler instability on 1 GPU shape during burst tests (OPT-342). Root cause suspected: incorrect node draining logic + race in load balancer.
- Metrics updated:
  - Customers with cost-saving config: 28% (up from 24% two weeks ago).
  - PRs merged last week: 4 (2 infra, 2 control-plane).
  - Eval pass rate: 94.8% (down slightly; regression on one tokenizer edge case).
  - Deep work hours: 9.5h last week (below target; meetings spiked).
- Two immediate actions:
  1) Schedule 1:1 with infra on autoscaler race (this week).
  2) Draft small eval fix for tokenizer edge case and ship as hotfix-run.

Experiment ledger (short form):
- EXP-001: Prefix caching tweak A/B (canary complete)
  - Hypothesis: adding LRU prefetch for mid-length prefixes will reduce repeated token compute and lower cost without increasing tail latency.
  - Outcome: cost -18% on replay set, p95 +6ms. Decide: roll to 25% of traffic, monitor regressions.
- EXP-014: Quantization profile alpha (internal env)
  - Hypothesis: new 4-bit recipe keeps quality within 1% on chat evals and halves memory footprint.
  - Outcome: quality delta +2.1% (worse), paused for tuning. Next step: revert for now, attach failing examples to ticket.

Blocked items & hypotheses to validate:
- Autoscaler race hypothesis: drain path sometimes leaves incomplete KV cache flush; need a repro test that simulates drain+burst (todo: add unit + integration test in release-engineering sandbox).
- Eval flakiness on tokenizer case: likely trim-normalization mismatch between older tokenizer version and new tokenizer. Hypothesis: a small pre-normalize pass will fix without model changes.

Personal improvement focus (my 3-month sprint):
1) Delegation: move two recurring ops tasks to SREs (create runbook + pairing sessions).
2) Improve meeting hygiene: protect three 90-minute blocks for deep work M/W/F.
3) Metric literacy: create a one-pager on signal definitions for Optimize so collaborators use consistent dashboards.

Retro notes (quick):
- What went well: shipped two infra PRs that unlocked experiment velocity; mentoring one new PM has been high-leverage.
- What didn't: context switching due to ad-hoc incident response. Need clearer on-call handoffs for Optimize experiments.
- Experimentation learnings: short experiments (1 week) give faster feedback; longer ones need pre-defined stop rules.

Open questions (to myself / later):
- Do I push for defaulting new customers onto the conservative cost config or continue opt-in? Pros/cons to map.
- Are we measuring the right evals for quantization? Need a short workshop with applied-ml to align.

Quick links & references (for when I return):
- OPT-342 (JIRA): autoscaler instability
- GH: optimize/pull/721: prefix-caching canary changes
- Confluence: RBW-Optimize-Cache-Playbook (draft)
- Slack thread: #optimize-ops (pinned: autoscaler postmortem)

Action items (next 7 days):
- Pair with infra to reproduce autoscaler race (owner: Samira)
- Ship tokenizer eval hotfix (owner: Samira + Evelyn)
- Create runbook outline for recurring experiment ops (owner: Samira)
- Block 3x 90m deep work slots for next week (owner: Samira)

Notes to self: keep this doc lean. When something surfaces that will matter to the team long term, move it to product/ or confluence. This is intentional: fast capture, frequent discard.
